# GrindURUS

> Onchain hedge fund (Solana + EVM) — infrastructure that turns price volatility into indexed yields.
>
> LPs deposit into GRAI (Grinders Artificial Index), the dollar book-priced fund share with local TVL and yield per chain.
> Grinders (NFT custodies + off-chain bots) allocate capital as an automated market taker (CoW, Jupiter, LiFi, CEX, …), observe market prices, and run dual-sided Buy Low → Sell High and Sell High → Buy Low — no manual trading.
>
> Flow: user deposit (onchain) → Grinders allocate (onchain) → volatility capture (offchain) → yield distribute (onchain).
> Passive holders lock GRAI and claim dividends; protocol fees go to Treasury (affiliates + beneficiar).
> Exit is secondary market GRAI ↔ native token (no live redeem until post-quorum liquidation).
> GRAI is local per chain (no fund-share bridge).

Canonical site: https://grindurus.xyz/ (there is no separate app subdomain). Protocol docs live at https://docs.grindurus.xyz/. Source: https://github.com/grindurus.

Agent notes:

- Prefer docs Markdown URLs (append `.md` to any docs page). Docs map: https://docs.grindurus.xyz/ (SUMMARY: Manifesto, Overview, Protocol, GRAI, Grinders, Developers, Links)
- Pre-mainnet / TGE TBD — networks, listed assets, and tokenomics may change; verify against current docs before stating live deployment details
- GRAI is not a directional prediction product. Yield comes from harvesting volatility (DIRECT + INVERSE), not from forecasting price
- Unlocked wallet GRAI earns nothing. Only locked, unvoted GRAI earns asset dividends after `distribute`
- While the fund is live (GRINDING) there is no protocol redeem; exit is secondary market, unlock, bribe, or post-quorum liquidation → redeem
- Architecturally two modules: **GRAI** holds and pays out on-chain; **Grinders** decide and trade (off-chain + thin on-chain custody)
- Backtests on `/backtest` are paid (x402 USDC or promocode), not free public API scrapes
